fulica-atra.titleZh: 白骨顶的图片曾经出过什么问题？（已修复）
fulica-atra.titleEn: What happened to the Eurasian Coot photos? (Fixed)
fulica-atra.bodyZh:
AI 调查结论

曾经的首图（现已撤下）里，主体其实是一只雀鹰在扑抓水面的白骨顶，白骨顶在背景里。iNaturalist 上这条观察（90178562）的首图票数最高，旧算法按“首图”取图才会出现这种情况。

修复分三步：① 改为优先使用物种的策展默认图（default_photo），并加入人工覆盖表兜底——现在首图是一张清晰的白骨顶（照片 123574818）；② 2026-10-21 复核时发现那张雀鹰照片仍排在画廊第 2 位，已从素材列表中移除（R2 旧文件保留备查、不再展示）；③ 同日补充 1 张清晰的白骨顶亲鸟带雏（iNaturalist 观察 17125901，Geoffrey Cox，CC BY-NC），现在共 5 张（1/3/4/5/6），首图仍是原来那张清晰的白骨顶。

这张观察在 iNaturalist 上仍是白骨顶（Fulica atra）：雀鹰只是画面主体，观察记录的是被扑抓的白骨顶。问题出在“取观察首图”的旧逻辑，不是物种标注。

同一物种的不同角度、季节、雌雄或幼鸟差异也很大。如果你仍看到旧图，多半是浏览器 / Service Worker 缓存，可用无痕窗口或清站点数据后重试。
fulica-atra.bodyEn:
AI investigation

The old first photo (now retired) actually showed a Eurasian Sparrowhawk grabbing a coot on the water, with the coot in the background. That observation (90178562) had the most-voted first photo on iNaturalist, and the old algorithm picked the observation’s first photo.

The fix had three steps: (1) prefer the species’ curated default photo and keep a manual override fallback — the current first photo is a clear coot (photo 123574818); (2) during a 2026-10-21 review we found the sparrowhawk photo was still in slot 2 of the gallery, so it has now been removed from the media list (the old R2 object is kept for auditing but no longer displayed); (3) on the same day we added a clear photo of an adult with chicks (iNaturalist obs 17125901, Geoffrey Cox, CC BY-NC), so the gallery now has 5 photos (1/3/4/5/6), with the original clear coot still as the first image.

The observation is still identified as a coot (Fulica atra) on iNaturalist: the sparrowhawk was only the subject of the photo, while the record is the coot being grabbed. The problem was the old “take the observation’s first photo” logic, not the species identification.

A species can also look quite different by angle, season, sex or age. If you still see the old photo, it is most likely a browser / Service Worker cache — try a private window or clear site data.

pica-serica.titleZh: 喜鹊的图片换过吗？为什么？
pica-serica.titleEn: Have the Oriental Magpie photos changed? Why?
pica-serica.bodyZh:
AI 调查结论

喜鹊原有 5 张图，其中 3 张不适合做认鸟练习，已停用并补入 3 张新图；现在展示的是原第 2、4 张 + 新增第 6、7、8 张，共 5 张。

8 张图一览（编号 = 加入顺序）：
1. 原图 1（iNaturalist 观察 253827966）— 已停用：主体与喜鹊不符
2. 原图 2（121031511）— 保留
3. 原图 3（38753010）— 已停用：画面模糊
4. 原图 4（121031510）— 保留
5. 原图 5（394144078）— 已停用：羽色异常，与典型喜鹊差异过大
6. 新图 6（205466820，CC0）— 新增
7. 新图 7（155853528，CC BY-NC）— 新增
8. 新图 8（384500520，CC BY-NC）— 新增

需要说明的是：这 8 条观察在 iNaturalist 上都被标注为喜鹊（Pica serica）。问题出在源站素材本身的质量与标注，而不是本站抓取时认错了物种。旧图仍保留在服务器上备查，只是不再展示。

感谢在「大众评审」指出问题的朋友——每一条反馈我们都会人工核对；确认有误的素材会停用并补充替换，同时在下方更新日志留痕。

开发者言

对于图一（之前考题中出现的图）我其实困惑过：它是喜鹊吗？但是没做进一步查证，以为是白化喜鹊或者是幼鸟。后续一直在试图完善项目的各种功能，也未及时找人求证。目前图一已经停用，并且对图三（模糊）、图五（白色浅色，疑似也是误标）也做了停用，然后额外新增了三张图。
pica-serica.bodyEn:
AI investigation

The Oriental Magpie used to have 5 photos; 3 of them were unsuitable for identification practice. They are retired and replaced with 3 new photos. The gallery now shows original #2 and #4 plus new #6, #7 and #8 (5 in total).

All 8 photos (numbering = order added):
1. Original 1 (iNaturalist obs 253827966) — retired: the subject is not a magpie
2. Original 2 (121031511) — kept
3. Original 3 (38753010) — retired: blurry
4. Original 4 (121031510) — kept
5. Original 5 (394144078) — retired: atypical plumage, too different from a typical magpie
6. New 6 (205466820, CC0) — added
7. New 7 (155853528, CC BY-NC) — added
8. New 8 (384500520, CC BY-NC) — added

All 8 observations are labelled Pica serica on iNaturalist. The problem was the quality/labelling of the source material, not a species misidentification on our side. The old files are kept on the server for auditing, but are no longer displayed.

Thanks to the person who reported this in Public Review — every report is checked manually; confirmed problems are retired and replaced, with a note in the changelog below.

Developer's note

I had doubts about image 1 (the one that appeared in earlier quizzes) — is it really a magpie? — but I did not verify it further and assumed it was a leucistic magpie or a juvenile. I kept working on other features and did not ask anyone to confirm in time. Image 1 is now retired; image 3 (blurry) and image 5 (pale/white, also suspected to be mislabelled) have been retired as well, and three new photos have been added.

phoenicurus-ochruros.titleZh: 赭红尾鸲的两张图为什么换掉了？（已修复）
phoenicurus-ochruros.titleEn: Why were two Black Redstart photos replaced? (Fixed)
phoenicurus-ochruros.bodyZh:
AI 调查结论

原素材 5 张里，编号 1 和 2 不适合出题：

· 图 1（观察 104811044，Valia Pavlou，CC BY-NC）是一张鸟环（脚环）在手指间的特写——这是环志记录的照片，画面里没有鸟体，无法用于认鸟。
· 图 2（观察 69149790，Luís Lourenço，CC BY-NC-ND）是一只几乎全身白色的白化/黄化个体，羽色不能代表这个物种；它同时是 ND 许可（不可转码），一直以原始 JPEG 直出。

处理：停用图 1、图 2；保留图 3/4/5；新增 2 张——雄鸟（观察 339875349，Константин Ординарцев，CC BY-NC）与雌鸟（观察 189450325，SteveM4560，CC BY）。新图使用从未占用过的编号（image-6、image-7），因此老用户不会因为缓存继续看到旧图；旧文件保留在服务器上备查，只是不再展示。

开发者言

这两张能进题库，是因为选图时只看「这条观察是否被标成该物种、票数是否高」，没有检查「画面里到底有没有可辨认的鸟、羽色是否典型」。环志照片在 iNaturalist 上很常见（研究者上传脚环/翅标特写），是最容易混进来的一类。已把这条写进纠错 SOP 的常见坑，并计划在质量门禁里加一道「主体必须可辨认」的检查。感谢反馈的朋友。
phoenicurus-ochruros.bodyEn:
AI findings

Two of the five photos were unsuitable:

· Photo 1 (obs 104811044, Valia Pavlou, CC BY-NC) is a close-up of a bird band (leg ring) held between fingers — a ringing record with no bird in frame, useless for identification.
· Photo 2 (obs 69149790, Luís Lourenço, CC BY-NC-ND) shows an almost entirely white leucistic individual, so its plumage does not represent the species; it is also ND-licensed (cannot be transcoded) and was served as the original JPEG.

Both were retired; photos 3/4/5 were kept; two were added — a male (obs 339875349, Konstantin Ordintsev, CC BY-NC) and a female (obs 189450325, SteveM4560, CC BY). The new files use never-used slots (image-6/7) so returning visitors never see stale cached images; the old objects remain on the server for reference but are no longer shown.

Developer note

They got in because selection only checked “is this observation labelled as the species and well voted”, not “is a recognisable bird actually visible, with typical plumage”. Ringing close-ups are common on iNaturalist, and this is the easiest category to slip through. It is now listed in the correction SOP, and a “subject must be recognisable” gate is planned for the quality checks.

anthus-japonicus.titleZh: 黄腹鹨的图 3（以及两张低清图）为什么换掉了？（已修复）
anthus-japonicus.titleEn: Why was the third Buff-bellied Pipit photo (and two low-res ones) replaced? (Fixed)
anthus-japonicus.bodyZh:
AI 调查结论

反馈指出图 3 不合适，核查后确认，并顺带发现另外两张也不达标：

· 图 3（观察 101151360，Steven Kurniawidjaja，CC BY-NC）：画面 1024×684，但鸟只占几十像素，缩在一片水泥地中间，完全无法辨认。
· 图 1（观察 248937056，Adam J. Searcy，CC BY）：母版只有 403×322，画面严重模糊——而它正是题目首图。
· 图 2（观察 10680482，mamu_man，CC BY-NC）：长边 517px，低于我们 1200px 的门槛，主体偏糊。

处理：停用图 1/2/3；保留图 4（1024px）与图 5（飞行图，ND 不可转码）；新增 3 张，长边均 ≥1260px——观察 142270736（saintsfc，CC BY-NC）、观察 409498438（Alexander Naumov，CC BY-NC）、观察 35359139（alexdersu，CC BY-NC）。新图占用 image-6/7/8，旧文件保留备查。现在首图是清晰的成鸟侧身照。

开发者言

问题不在“认错物种”，在于分辨率与主体大小没有硬门槛：旧流程按票数取图，票数高的不一定是清晰可用的。图 3 那种“远景里有个小点”的照片，人眼一扫就知道不能用，但算法看不出来。已把「长边 ≥1200px、主体可辨认」列为采集与复核的硬条件，并计划在质量门禁里用模型做一次预筛（识别不出鸟就淘汰）。感谢指出问题的朋友。
anthus-japonicus.bodyEn:
AI findings

A report flagged photo 3; on review it was indeed unusable, and two more fell below our bar:

· Photo 3 (obs 101151360, Steven Kurniawidjaja, CC BY-NC): 1024×684, but the bird is only a few dozen pixels wide, lost in a large concrete area — impossible to identify.
· Photo 1 (obs 248937056, Adam J. Searcy, CC BY): the master is only 403×322 and badly blurred — and it was the quiz image.
· Photo 2 (obs 10680482, mamu_man, CC BY-NC): 517px on the long edge, below our 1200px bar, and soft.

All three were retired; photos 4 (1024px) and 5 (a flight shot, ND, not transcodable) were kept; three were added, all ≥1260px on the long edge — obs 142270736 (saintsfc, CC BY-NC), obs 409498438 (Alexander Naumov, CC BY-NC), obs 35359139 (alexdersu, CC BY-NC). They use slots image-6/7/8; the old objects remain for reference. The first image is now a sharp adult in side profile.

Developer note

The mistake was not a misidentification but the lack of hard bars on resolution and subject size: the old flow picked by vote count, and high votes do not imply a usable image. A “tiny bird in a distant frame” is obvious to a human at a glance but invisible to the algorithm. “Long edge ≥1200px and a recognisable subject” is now a hard requirement for collection and review, and an automated pre-screen (reject if no bird is detected) is planned.

anas-platyrhynchos.titleZh: 绿头鸭的图片换过吗？为什么？
anas-platyrhynchos.titleEn: Have the Mallard photos changed? Why?
anas-platyrhynchos.bodyZh:
AI 调查结论

绿头鸭原有 5 张图，其中 4 张不适合做认鸟练习，已停用并补入 4 张新图；现在展示的是新增的第 6、7、8、9 张 + 保留的原第 1 张，共 5 张。

9 张图一览（编号 = 加入顺序）：
1. 原图 1（iNaturalist 照片 95268822）— 保留：雄鸟与雌鸟并肩站立，标准侧身，特征完整
2. 原图 2（观察 8174772）— 已停用：家鸭的凤头品种，头顶毛冠，不是野生绿头鸭形态
3. 原图 3（观察 13447878）— 已停用：小鸭群，无法确认是否为绿头鸭幼鸟，作为题目不可用
4. 原图 4（观察 21203884）— 已停用：白色家鸭，不是绿头鸭
5. 原图 5（观察 39432879）— 已停用：雌鸟背光停在喂食器上，侧后角度，主体难辨
6. 新图 6（观察 254201604，CC BY-NC）— 新增：雄鸟水面近照，头颈绿色与胸部紫褐清晰
7. 新图 7（观察 108300981，CC BY-NC）— 新增：雄鸟立于雪地，正面偏侧，羽色完整
8. 新图 8（观察 158495089，CC BY-NC）— 新增：雌鸟飞行，翼镜与羽色可辨
9. 新图 9（观察 189928707，CC BY-NC）— 新增：两只雄鸟水面争偶，展示翼展与颈环

这些观察在 iNaturalist 上都被标注为绿头鸭。素材有问题就是有问题：城市水域里家鸭、白色家鸭与绿头鸭的后代很多，混进素材库难以避免，靠大家报错，我们逐一核对修正。旧图仍保留在服务器上备查，只是不再展示。

感谢做题时点「报错」指出问题的朋友——每一条反馈我们都会人工核对；确认有误的素材会停用并补充替换，同时在下方更新日志留痕。
anas-platyrhynchos.bodyEn:
AI investigation

The Mallard used to have 5 photos; 4 of them were unsuitable for identification practice. They are retired and replaced with 4 new photos. The gallery now shows new #6, #7, #8, #9 plus original #1 (5 in total).

All 9 photos (numbering = order added):
1. Original 1 (iNaturalist photo 95268822) — kept: male and female standing side by side, standard profile, all key marks visible
2. Original 2 (obs 8174772) — retired: a crested domestic duck with a head tuft, not wild Mallard plumage
3. Original 3 (obs 13447878) — retired: a brood of ducklings that cannot be confirmed as Mallard, unusable as a quiz subject
4. Original 4 (obs 21203884) — retired: a white domestic duck, not a Mallard
5. Original 5 (obs 39432879) — retired: a backlit female on a feeder, rear three-quarter angle, subject unrecognisable
6. New 6 (obs 254201604, CC BY-NC) — added: male close-up on water, green head and chestnut breast clear
7. New 7 (obs 108300981, CC BY-NC) — added: male standing on snow, front three-quarter, plumage complete
8. New 8 (obs 158495089, CC BY-NC) — added: female in flight, speculum and plumage visible
9. New 9 (obs 189928707, CC BY-NC) — added: two males competing on water, showing wingspan and neck ring

All 9 observations are labelled Mallard on iNaturalist. Wrong material is wrong material: city waters hold many domestic ducks, white farm ducks and Mallard hybrids, and they inevitably slip in. Reports from players are how they get found and fixed, one by one. The old files remain on our server for reference; they are simply no longer shown.

Thanks to the people who used the Report button during a quiz to flag these — every report is checked by hand; confirmed problems are retired and replaced, and the change is recorded in the changelog below.

eurystomus-orientalis.titleZh: 三宝鸟的图一换过吗？为什么？
eurystomus-orientalis.titleEn: Has the Dollarbird first photo changed? Why?
eurystomus-orientalis.bodyZh:
AI 调查结论

三宝鸟原有 5 张图，其中图一不适合做认鸟练习，已停用并补入 1 张新图；现在展示的是新增的第 6 张 + 保留的原第 2、3、4、5 张，共 5 张。

6 张图一览（编号 = 加入顺序）：
1. 原图 1（iNaturalist 照片 238508830，观察 139456684，CC BY-NC-ND）— 已停用：画面主体不是三宝鸟（是红嘴蓝鹊），且该照片是 ND 许可、不可转码
2. 原图 2（观察 190546156，CC BY-NC）— 保留：飞行姿态，翼上浅蓝色斑块清晰
3. 原图 3（观察 201901836，CC BY-NC）— 保留：停枝侧身，红喙与暗绿褐色体羽可辨
4. 原图 4（观察 393166453，CC BY-NC）— 保留：幼鸟，头部褐色、喉部偏紫，特征正确
5. 原图 5（观察 337516807，CC BY-NC）— 保留：俯冲飞行，翼下白色斑块明显
6. 新图 6（观察 221758152，CC BY-NC，原图 1440×1080）— 新增：单只正面停在枝上，红喙与体色完整，现为题目首图

需要说明的是：原图一来自 iNaturalist 上三宝鸟这个物种的默认图，它的观察 139456684 只有这一张照片，却被社区标为三宝鸟并达到 research grade、按票数排在第一。也就是说，源站的标注本身就是错的，而本站抓取时优先采用物种默认图、又没有逐张复核，才让一只红嘴蓝鹊成了三宝鸟的图一和题目首图。这一张是我们选取与复核环节的疏漏，不是「两种鸟长得像」的问题。旧图仍保留在服务器上备查，只是不再展示。

感谢指出问题的朋友——正是这样的反馈让我们发现，同一物种的素材必须逐张看过，不能因为「源站标了」就直接采用。
eurystomus-orientalis.bodyEn:
AI investigation

The Dollarbird used to have 5 photos. Photo 1 was unsuitable for identification practice, so it is retired and replaced by 1 new photo. The gallery now shows new #6 plus original #2, #3, #4 and #5 (5 in total).

All 6 photos (numbering = order added):
1. Original 1 (iNaturalist photo 238508830 / obs 139456684, CC BY-NC-ND) — retired: the subject is not a Dollarbird (it is a Red-billed Blue Magpie), and the ND licence also forbids transcoding
2. Original 2 (obs 190546156, CC BY-NC) — kept: flight pose, pale blue wing patches clearly visible
3. Original 3 (obs 201901836, CC BY-NC) — kept: perched side profile, red bill and dark green-brown plumage visible
4. Original 4 (obs 393166453, CC BY-NC) — kept: juvenile with brown head and purplish throat, correct identification
5. Original 5 (obs 337516807, CC BY-NC) — kept: stooping flight with white underwing patches
6. New 6 (obs 221758152, CC BY-NC, original 1440×1080) — added: single bird perched facing the camera, red bill and plumage complete; now the quiz lead image

To be clear: photo 1 was the default photo of the Dollarbird taxon on iNaturalist. Its observation 139456684 contains only that single photo, yet the community identified it as a Dollarbird to research grade and it ranked first by votes. The source annotation itself was wrong, and because our pipeline prefers the taxon default photo without verifying each image, a Red-billed Blue Magpie became the Dollarbird's first gallery image and quiz lead. That was a gap in our selection and review, not a case of two similar-looking species. The old photo remains on our servers for reference but is no longer shown.

Thanks to the person who reported it — feedback like this is what shows that every image for a species has to be looked at, rather than trusted because "the source labelled it".
